connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib library dependency. Not a parameter.

metadataDb.title: Metadata database
metadataDb.description: Connection to the SQL database hosting the Superset metadata. Its credentials Secret holds the keys username and password.

examplesDb.title: Examples database
examplesDb.description: Connection to the PostgreSQL database receiving the Superset examples (used when Load examples is on).

locale.title: Chart locale
locale.description: CLDR locale used by charts to render numbers and dates, for instance en, fr, fr-CH or es. The UI language is not affected.

currency.title: Chart currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code, for instance EUR. Defaults to the currency of the locale territory when the locale carries one.

d3Format.title: Number format overrides
d3Format.description: d3-format locale definition, applied over the one derived from locale. See https://github.com/d3/d3-format#formatLocale

d3TimeFormat.title: Date format overrides
d3TimeFormat.description: d3-time-format locale definition, applied over the one derived from locale. See https://github.com/d3/d3-time-format#timeFormatLocale

cpu.title: CPU (vCPU)
cpu.description: CPU limit of the Superset web server.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Memory limit of the Superset web server.

workers.title: Server workers
workers.description: Gunicorn workers of the web server.

oidcRoleMapping.title: Role mapping
oidcRoleMapping.description: Map of OIDC roles (groups) to lists of Superset roles.

datasources.title: Trino datasources
datasources.description: One Superset database per item, on a Trino instance and one of its catalogs.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name in the Superset UI.

trino.title: Trino
trino.description: Trino connection, or a trino release of this project.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Trino catalog to expose, as named on the Trino instance.
